name: OracleEconLab Oracle Incentives and Accountability v1
description: Review-sized, audit-first UMA economic episodes, A/B/C measures and decision-time evaluation records.
citeAs: Oracle-Nature Contributors (2026), OracleEconLab Economic Research Release v1.5.0.
rai:dataCollection: Software collection of public Polygon and Ethereum protocol records, fixed RPC snapshots, deterministic cross-chain linkage and versioned transformations.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Canonical contract events, transaction receipts, token transfers and protocol source semantics.
rai:dataCollectionMissingData: Unknown, unavailable, not applicable, verified zero and right-censored states are distinct; off-chain investigation effort and most independent factual outcomes are unavailable.
rai:dataLimitations: The AI cohort conditions on actually challenged UMA proposals and cannot identify policy value for undisputed requests.
Protocol adjudication is not independent factual truth.
Address-level activity is not verified person- or institution-level activity.
The review draft is not the full cross-protocol ledger and requires archive infrastructure for complete recollection.

Observed chain records are real; model predictions and derived evaluation outputs are machine-generated. Core metadata validation does not establish independent factual truth or full-Atlas completeness.
rai:dataBiases: Selection favors challenged requests with exact Grade-A linkage and flow evidence.
UMA and Polymarket-style adapter activity are over-represented relative to less observable oracle mechanisms.
rai:personalSensitiveInformation: Public pseudonymous blockchain addresses and transaction hashes are present; no natural-person identity mapping is asserted.
No private RPC endpoint, API credential, private key or off-chain personal profile is released.
Public wallet addresses can be linked across transactions and may be re-identified using outside information; do not treat pseudonymity as anonymity.
rai:dataUseCases: Conditional protocol-outcome evaluation with calibration, leakage checks and abstention.
Not validated for production challenge automation, causal truthfulness claims or identity inference.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The resource can improve transparency around who bears verification costs and how accountability is realized, but misuse as an automated challenge policy could impose financial losses or amplify selective-label bias.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.sc:description: Historical generation of the archived review tables; exact original execution commit is not established for every table. Byte identity is pinned; retrospective source mappings must not be mistaken for a fresh scientific rerun.

rai:dataReleaseMaintenancePlan: Keep immutable historical revisions; publish corrected outputs with new manifests, code identities and before/after validation. Contact the repository issue tracker for reproducible data issues.
